fields.name: id
fields.description: Opaque, stable identifier of the event, never renamed: `plone-conference-<year>`, `wpd-<date>-<location>`, `wpd-<year>-online`, or the slug of the name of a sprint or symposium.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: `conference` for the Plone Conference of a year, `symposium` for a regional conference, `wpd` for a World Plone Day event of one place or online, `sprint` for a sprint.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The name of the event; a World Plone Day event is named after its year and place.

fields.name: year
fields.description: The year of the event; an event without a start date has one too.

fields.name: start
fields.description: The first day of the event; the sources of a sprint sometimes give only a year or a month, a World Plone Day event has its day.

fields.name: end
fields.description: The last day of the event, in the same form as the start; empty for a single day.

fields.name: format
fields.description: For a World Plone Day event: whether it was held in person, as a hybrid or online.

fields.name: level
fields.description: For a sprint: whether it was a strategic or a community sprint.

fields.name: sources
fields.description: The ids of the sources in the source register that support the row; empty only for the events the migration made to hold the rows pointing to them, `plone-conference-<year>` and `wpd-<year>-online`. Several values are separated by semicolons.

fields.name: cited_as
fields.description: The sources of the row in words, as the community page shows and links them: the web addresses of the sources in `sources`, with their labels and quotes, such as `https://…; Board: https://…`. A row from before the source register keeps its old source cell here verbatim. Empty when the row has no sources.
